name: The Architectural Work of Le Corbusier, an Outstanding Contribution to the Modern Movement
countries: India, Japan, France, Belgium, Switzerland, Argentina, Germany
description: Seventeen buildings by the Franco-Swiss architect Le Corbusier are scattered across seven countries, from Chandigarh's government complex in India to a Marseille apartment block, a Tokyo art museum and a house in La Plata, Argentina. Built over about fifty years, they showcase raw concrete, glass and steel in a bold break from ornament. Together they show how modern design travelled the world.
